name: ez-thumb
description: YouTube thumbnail and title packaging studio for Claude Code. Onboard once: it finds your competitors (vidIQ or your own list), pulls their best thumbnails through Apify, reads every image with vision, and writes the whole corpus back into itself. After that /ez-thumb packages any video against evidence from your actual niche instead of generic thumbnail advice.
author: Charles J Dove (https://www.charlieautomates.com/)
